notes.title: Version 1.3 Update: 日本語 Language Support!
notes.notes: [p][u][b]**SCROLL TO BOTTOM FOR WARNING ABOUT SAVE DATA**[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]Konnichiwa! This is Jun, the creator of YAKG YET again to talk about the latest version update![/p][p][/p][p]Version 1.3 of "Yet Another Killing Game" is now available! The main update here is the addition of Japanese language support, which is an ENORMOUS achievement for a 10,000+ dialogue line story-focused game like this! I cannot express enough thanks to the Japanese translator, Sasazaki, for providing a full translation to Japanese this quickly, but also for supporting me ever since the release of the very first YAKG demo in 2023--which is still available on itch.io, if anyone wants to check that out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206903/44a22e9707b9022cbcda6b60277aca325b7e066b.png"][/img][/p][p]Please note that if you attempt to load save files created in one language with the other language, you may experience some unexpected text display issues with chapter and character names. If you’re a returning player, I highly recommend starting yet ANOTHER new (killing) game if you want to check out the Japanese localization! Yep, “localization” in that there are some scenes and jokes that have been given new meaning, but I have personally reviewed them all so play without worry![/p][p][/p][p]BUT WAIT, there are other updates besides Japanese language support! Tutorial images have been updated based on player feedback, Achievement progress can reset anytime now (with a clear warning about Steam data!), and the rest consists of small updates to visuals. No changes have been made to the script itself so--in theory--this shouldn’t cause any save data issues, but the usual warning will be added to the bottom all the same.[/p][p][/p][p]Time for the full update notes![/p][p][/p][p][b]V1.3[/b][/p][list][*][p]NEW FEATURE: Japanese is now available in Config’s “Language” setting! Switch to “Japanese” to view the entire game’s script and textual UI elements in Japanese, including the game’s logo![/p][/*][*][p]A screen to choose the game’s language appears when booting up while no save data exists yet[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Japanese translator to About and the credits[/p][/*][*][p]The About screen’s formatting has been updated[/p][/*][*][p]Achievement data can now be deleted at any time, and the warning has been corrected to state that the deletion may also affect any attached Steam account[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu’s background image sequence has been updated, and the main menu’s game logo is now animated and hides when the game menu opens[/p][/*][*][p]The sequence when starting a new game has been visually updated[/p][/*][*][p]The game logo is now larger during credits and other scenes it appears[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the tutorial images for “Controls”, “Skipping Read Text”, and one more significantly[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes to several other tutorial images[/p][/*][*][p]The icon at the end of dialogue lines now indicates if the current line has been read before[/p][/*][*][p]Minor script revisions to handle localized text entry[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]WARNING ABOUT SAVE DATA[/b][/u][/p][p]Due to script changes in later versions, some save files you made in V1.2 (or earlier) of the demo or full game MAY not load correctly (i.e. crash, show an error message, return you to the Title Screen). As such...[/p][p][/p][p][b]IF YOU ARE IN THE MIDDLE OF YOUR FIRST PLAYTHROUGH[/b], we strongly recommend creating multiple save files and/or finishing your playthrough BEFORE you update to V1.2! If worst comes to worst, please start a new game and utilize the skip features in Config to catch yourself up. Sorry for any inconveniences![/p][p][/p][p]As a tiny indie team based in Canada, we frankly have no clue how we’re going to get YAKG in front of Japanese players, but we will do research and try our best! If you’re a fan of YAKG, please support us by telling more people to check out the demo and buy it while it’s on sale! It really makes a world of difference for us![/p][p][/p][p]そして、日本人の皆様へ！まだ日本語勉強していますが、これは自分の言葉で伝えてみます。この作品が好きになったら、ぜひサポートしてください！友人に見せたり、有名なYouTuberにタッグしたり、私たちのDiscordに入ったり…この小さなチームに本当に助かるのでお願いします！[/p][p][/p][p]More updates are still underway so please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Regards,[/p][p]Jun Kakeru より[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update: Get up to SIXTY (60) Achievements!
notes.notes: [p][u][b]**SCROLL TO BOTTOM FOR WARNING ABOUT SAVE DATA**[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]Salutations! 'Tis I, Jun, the creator of YAKG![/p][p][/p][p]I am happy to announce that Version 1.2 of "Yet Another Killing Game" is now available! This upcoming MAJOR update includes a highly requested feature: [b]ACHIEVEMENTS~[/b] It also has a massive range of fixes and improvements based on feedback and observational data collected over the past few months (see them all in the update notes further down this announcement!)[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]About Achievements[/b][/u][/p][p]Fans of YAKG will know that this game has many, MANY hidden details and secrets, and our hope with the Achievement system is that it will guide players who've already reached the ultimate truth to seek out other truths they may have missed![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206903/1e590274eccd9626860caa5459634313154d304b.png"][/img][/p][p]The Achievements screen can be accessed from anywhere in the game! ALSO, if you have cleared the full game, each locked Achievement will give you a little hint as to how to unlock it! Are you up to the challenge of finding all 60 (that's right, six-zero!) Achievements and becoming an epic KILLING gamer?![/p][p][/p][p]Here are the full update notes![/p][p][/p][p]V1.2[/p][list][*][p]NEW FEATURE: Achievements! Discover 60 Achievements throughout the full version of Yet Another Killing Game! (Achievements are unavailable in the demo version.)[/p][/*][*][p]STEAM VERSION ONLY: Achievements will also unlock their equivalents in Steam Achievements! Collect special icons for your Steam profile![/p][/*][*][p]New tutorial added: “Choice Menus”[/p][/*][*][p]While playing on Gamepad, you can now hide the UI by clicking the left or right sticks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the music info tab being erroneously read by accessibility features while it is hidden[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with text related to Investigations not being read by accessibility features[/p][/*][*][p]Investigations can now be ended by a choice menu before reaching 100% Investigation Progress[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the tooltip for “Use Ren’Py Features”[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the icon names for quick menu buttons while “Use Ren’Py Features” is active[/p][/*][*][p]Added “LOAD” to the quick menu while “Use Ren’Py Features” is active[/p][/*][*][p]In Gallery, the title screen no longer appears behind when viewing large background images[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual clarity for certain endings’ screens[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to quickly load a save file after reaching certain endings[/p][/*][*][p]Updated a certain choice screen to be more obvious about a secret option[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain text colours[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the background visuals for the final version of the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Added the creator of the Achievements framework to About and the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some unused assets[/p][/*][*][p]Several script corrections and improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]WARNING ABOUT SAVE DATA[/b][/u][/p][p]Due to some script changes, some save files you made in V1.1 (or earlier) of the demo or full game MAY not load correctly (i.e. crash, show an error message, return you to the Title Screen). As such...[/p][p][/p][p][b]IF YOU ARE IN THE MIDDLE OF YOUR FIRST PLAYTHROUGH[/b], we strongly recommend creating multiple save files and/or finishing your playthrough BEFORE you update to V1.2! If worst comes to worst, please start a new game and utilize the skip features in Config to catch yourself up. Sorry for any inconveniences![/p][p][/p][p]Version 1.2 will also be accompanied by our BIGGEST DISCOUNT sale yet: 33% OFF! Get ready to spread the [strike]killing[/strike] love to your friends and let's get YAKG even more popular~[/p][p][/p][p]Regards,[/p][p][/p][p]Jun Kakeru[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update: New "Sprites" Gallery INCOMING~
notes.notes:
[u][b]**SCROLL TO BOTTOM FOR WARNING ABOUT SAVE DATA**[/b][/u]

Hello, this is Jun, the creator of YAKG!

Thank you all for the amazing launch of "Yet Another Killing Game"! The dev team and I were so thrilled by the reception that we voluntarily did another round of tweaks, improving artwork, music, and the in-game hints that lead you to the TRUTH!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206903/9127cc234404d831a653376bdf3115c1b77d6af9.png[/img]

A major update of V1.1 is a new "Sprites" section in the Gallery! Once you clear the full game, you can browse through every character sprite that appears in the game. The background is set to a greenscreen in hopes that our more creative fans will screenshot and edit together their own creations with the YAKG characters~ (And share it with us if you do!)

Here are the full update notes!

V1.1
[list]
[*] New “Sprites” section added to Gallery (unlocked after clearing the game!)
[*] Made it easier to notice if you are on track to unlock the final Background in the Gallery
[*] Updated the post-credits text after certain Endings to give more specific hints
[*] Updated the names in the credits
[*] Made it easier to notice how to skip the credits (just try to advance dialogue!)
[*] Small corrections made to several portrait sprites, several background images, and one music track
[*] Adjusted positioning for 1 Clue in a mid-game Investigation to match its updated background art
[*] Minor text corrections and script updates
[/list]
[u][b]WARNING ABOUT SAVE DATA[/b][/u]
Due to some script changes, some save files you made in V1.0 of the demo or full game MAY not load correctly (i.e. crash, show an error message, return you to the Title Screen). As such...

[b]IF YOU ARE IN THE MIDDLE OF YOUR FIRST PLAYTHROUGH[/b], we strongly recommend creating multiple save files and/or finishing your playthrough BEFORE you update to V1.1! If worst comes to worst, please start a new game and utilize the skip features in Config to catch yourself up. Sorry for any inconveniences!

Version 1.1 will go live on Tuesday, Feb 11! Please look forward to it!

Regards,

Jun Kakeru
